'''Grabvine Gateway''' was a [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] track on the planet of [[Baroonda/Legends|Baroonda]]. This course was the third race in the [[Galactic Podracing Circuit/Legends|Galactic Podracing Circuit]] tournament. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was the track favorite in the race, although it is doubtful whether he ever raced there.

==Other Tracks of [[Baroonda/Legends|Baroonda]]==
*[[Semipro Podracing Circuit|Semipro Circuit]] track: [[Baroo Coast/Legends|Baroo Coast]]
*Other [[Galactic Podracing Circuit/Legends|Galactic Circuit]] track: [[Fire Mountain Rally/Legends|Fire Mountain Rally]]
*[[Invitational Podracing Circuit|Invitational Circuit]] track: [[Inferno (track)|Inferno]]
